content.title: Through The Depths
about: Through The Depths is a 2D platformer developed as a university project without using a game engine.
The project was built on top of SDL2 and a physics library, focusing on low-level control of gameplay, collisions, and rendering.
I was responsible for the programming side of the project, implementing gameplay and core systems.
features: Player movement, jumping, and combat/interaction basics for a platformer loop
Physics-based collisions and responsive platforming feel
Custom gameplay systems built directly on SDL2
learnings: Building gameplay directly on low-level libraries (without an engine)
Tuning platformer feel through collisions and movement parameters
Structuring a small game project for maintainability
